name: The Hand of Midas

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Each base-game wild adds a 1x, 2x or 3x multiplier to the total win.

features.name: Minimum win bonus
features.description: The bonus pays at least 10x, 20x or 30x depending on scatters.

features.name: Sticky wilds
features.description: Wilds stay in place for the whole free-spins round.

review:
A Greek-myth game where every wild in the base game adds a random 1x, 2x or 3x to the spin's total win, stacking up when several land.

Three, four or five scatters trigger a bonus with an assured minimum win of 10x, 20x or 30x. Each scatter spins a mini reel for one to three spins (up to 45 with five), and wilds stick throughout. If the minimum isn't reached, you get extra spins to get there. Up to 5,000x, 96.54% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
